answers.answer: Build three separately shuffled tiers: top is 1 randomly dealt Conflict I; next 5 randomly dealt Conflict II; bottom all 4 Conflict III in shuffled order. Return unused Conflict cards to the box without looking.

Each human starts with 2 Agents on the Leader and the third (Swordmaster) beside the board; 3 troops in the garrison and 9 in supply; 1 water; one cube at the bottom of each of four Influence tracks (0 Influence); VP marker at 0 in a 3-player game and 1 in a 4-player game.

Yes. You may Reveal while Agents remain. After Revealing, your turns are skipped for the rest of the phase, so you cannot take another Agent turn; Plot Intrigue may be played only during your own Agent or Reveal turns, so you cannot play one later in the phase.

Play one card from hand with a matching Agent icon, choose only one icon, and send one Agent to an unoccupied board space. A card without Agent icons cannot be used. Meet requirements and pay entry costs immediately before resolving any space/card effects; if unable to pay, you cannot enter.

No. Entry costs are paid before resolving effects of the space or played card, so the card’s spice gain cannot fund Conspire’s 4-spice entry cost when you have only 3. After paying, resolve the space effect, card Agent box, and one-space Faction Influence advancement in any order.

Maximum 5: all 3 troops recruited this turn plus up to 2 of the 4 already in your garrison. Undeployed recruits remain in the garrison. Rally Troops is not a Combat space, so its recruits normally go to the garrison and cannot deploy there.

Reveal all remaining hand cards; resolve those cards’ Reveal boxes in any order; set Combat strength; clean up. Reveal boxes are only for cards revealed now, not cards played on Agent turns. At cleanup, all cards in front of you from Agent and Reveal turns go to your discard pile.

Yes, the Row refills immediately, so you may buy the replacement if affordable. Persuasion can be pooled across sources for one card or split across cards. Leftover Persuasion is lost; acquired cards go to discard and cannot be used immediately. An Acquire box resolves once when the card is acquired.

3 troops are 6 strength plus 4 swords = 10. If your last Conflict troop is removed, strength becomes 0 and cannot be increased, even by swords. Above 20, flip the Combat marker to its +20 side and start again from the beginning of the track.

Players with at least one Conflict troop act starting with First Player and clockwise; each may play any number of Combat Intrigue cards or pass. A pass does not bind later turns. Resolve after all involved players pass consecutively. “When you win” cards are played only after winning, before the next phase.

A and B tie for first, so nobody wins; each gets the second reward. C and D then compete for the third reward, which C gets as the higher of them (D gets nothing). A first-place tie is not a win for win-trigger effects. A second-place tie gives each tied player the third reward, even in 2- or 3-player games; a third-place tie gives nothing; 0 strength gets no reward. After rewards, troops go to supply and markers reset to 0.

In Phase 4 Makers, after Combat, add 1 spice from bank to each Maker space without an Agent, accumulating prior bonus spice. The spaces are Great Flat, Hagga Basin, and Imperial Basin. Harvest by sending an Agent to a space in its turn; it gains base spice plus accumulated bonus. If an Agent moves away before Phase 4 and the space is empty then, bonus spice accumulates.
answers.evidence: Phase 4: Makers; Board spaces; Maker spaces clarification

answers.answer: The game-end check is at end-of-round Recall: if someone is at 10+ VP or Conflict Deck is empty, game ends. Resolve Endgame Intrigue cards first, then highest VP wins. Ties break in order: spice, Solari, water, garrisoned troops (not supply troops), then the player who most recently took a Reveal turn.

At 2 Influence you gain 1 VP, lost if you fall below 2 and regained if you reach 2 again. At 4 you gain the track bonus; you keep it if you later drop below 4 and can earn it again by dropping and advancing back. First to 4 takes the Alliance and its VP. Another player takes it only by advancing to a higher Influence than holder; tying alone does not take it.

If the holder loses Influence while tied with others, a previously tied player takes the Alliance; if several were tied, holder chooses one. If instead holder was alone at 4 and drops to 3, they lose it; with no player at 4+, return it to the board.

Discard means a card from hand goes to discard pile. Trashing permanently removes a card from hand, discard pile, or in play to the box; a Reserve card returns to its Reserve stack. Trashing is optional except when paying a cost or instructed to trash itself. The summary says an empty deck cannot be reshuffled early to inspect its top card.

A controller gets 1 Solari when anyone sends an Agent to Arrakeen or Carthag, or 1 spice at Imperial Basin. Winning the matching Conflict gives control: place your marker on the flag, replacing an opponent’s. When a matching Conflict is revealed later for a space you already control, you may deploy one troop from supply to the Conflict.

In every standard 2-player game, use House Hagal as a third Rival: choose unused color; cube at bottom of each Influence track, rest in supply, no garrison troops; remove three Arrakeen 1P cards; shuffle remaining Hagal cards and place deck plus three Agents by supply. It acts after each First Player Agent turn (up to three; see Q59), never Reveals, and does not collect resources, build a deck, earn Conflict rewards or score VP. It can hold Alliances.
answers.evidence: Two-player House Hagal Rival: Setup; Agent turns

answers.answer: If indicated space is occupied, reveal another card until an eligible unoccupied space appears; a two-space card uses only the condition-matching option, and if occupied draw another card rather than switch options. Reshuffle immediately when deck empties or Reshuffle appears. Ignore space costs, requirements and effects; resolve only card icons/instructions. Troop icons recruit; deploy recruited troops on Combat spaces, otherwise garrison them. Every Combat-space visit automatically deploys up to 2 more garrison troops (or 1/0 if fewer available). Harvest Spice chooses Maker space with most bonus spice, tie-break by total base+bonus spice; if no bonus spice exists reveal another card. Harvested bonus spice returns to bank.
answers.evidence: Two-player House Hagal Rival: Agent turns

answers.answer: If Hagal has a troop in Conflict, at start of Combat reveal a Hagal card (reshuffling and revealing again if Reshuffle), add its sword icons to 2 per deployed troop; then humans may play Combat Intrigue cards. Hagal gets no reward but occupies its rank. A second-place tie pays each tied human the third reward, even though ordinary third place pays only in 4-player games. If Hagal wins a Conflict for a human-controlled space, remove that Control marker; Hagal does not replace it.
answers.evidence: Two-player House Hagal Rival: Combat strength procedure

answers.answer: At Round Start reveal top Conflict card and each player draws 5 cards. In ordinary Recall, return Mentat to Landsraad if needed, recall Agents to Leaders, pass First Player marker clockwise, then begin next round. Sort Through the Chaos winner takes Mentat at start of next round.
Solari, spice and water are not limited; use substitutes if bank runs out. If your troop supply is out, you cannot recruit more until troops return.

A Leader’s Signet Ring ability activates when you play Signet Ring on one of your Agent turns; each Leader’s other unique ability operates as described on that Leader. Cards of any type can override usual rules.

Sietch Tabr is City icon, requires 2+ Fremen Influence, recruits 1 troop and gains 1 water. It is a Combat space, so a visiting Agent permits deployment under the Combat-space rules. You cannot enter at 1 Influence and use the card’s effect to reach 2 because requirements/costs must be met before effects resolve.
answers.evidence: Board spaces; Combat spaces; Agent turn

answers.answer: Combat spaces: Arrakeen, Carthag, Sietch Tabr, Research Station, Imperial Basin, Hagga Basin, Great Flat, Heighliner, Hardy Warriors, and Stillsuits. Thus Research Station and Great Flat are Combat spaces; Conspire is not.

Wealth (Emperor): no cost, +1 Emperor Influence, 2 Solari. Conspire (Emperor): 4 spice, +1 Emperor Influence, 5 Solari, recruit 2, draw Intrigue. Foldspace (Guild): no cost, +1 Guild Influence, acquire Foldspace from Reserve. Heighliner (Guild): 6 spice, +1 Guild Influence, recruit 5, gain 2 water. Secrets (Bene Gesserit): no cost, +1 Influence, draw Intrigue; each opponent with 4+ Intrigue gives you one random card. Selective Breeding (Bene Gesserit): 2 spice, +1 Influence, trash one card to draw two. Stillsuits (Fremen): no cost, +1 Influence, gain 1 water. Hardy Warriors (Fremen): 1 water, +1 Influence, recruit 2.

Arrakeen (City): no cost; recruit 1 and draw a card; controller gains 1 Solari. Carthag (City): no cost; recruit 1 and draw Intrigue; controller gains 1 Solari. Research Station (City): 2 water; draw 3 cards. Secure Contract (Spice Trade): no cost; gain 3 Solari. Imperial Basin (Maker/Spice Trade): no cost; gain 1 spice plus bonus spice; controller gains 1 spice. Hagga Basin: 1 water; gain 2 spice plus bonus. Great Flat: 2 water; gain 3 spice plus bonus.
Sell Melange is Spice Trade icon. Pay 2/3/4/5 spice to gain 6/8/10/12 Solari respectively; one exchange per turn.

High Council costs 5 Solari, once per game; place Councilor on an unoccupied seat and gain 2 Persuasion during each Reveal turn for rest of game. Swordmaster costs 8 Solari, once per game; gain third Agent and place it on Leader, available for rest of game including this round.

Hall of Oratory (Landsraad) costs nothing, recruits 1; if your Agent is there, gain 1 Persuasion during Reveal. Rally Troops (Landsraad) costs 4 Solari and recruits 4 troops to garrison (not Combat space). Mentat (Landsraad) costs 2 Solari and draws a card; if Mentat is there, take it as an Agent this round and return during Recall.
Yes, a recalled Agent returns to your Leader and may be used on another Agent turn that same round. Recall effects do not reopen turns after your Reveal turn.

Fremen Bond works if another Fremen card is in play, including a card played on Agent turn and one revealed on Reveal turn. Cards remain face up in play until Clean Up unless trashed first. Two Bond cards enable each other regardless of play order.
answers.evidence: Special Rules: In play / Fremen Bond

answers.answer: A single gain-two-Influence effect cannot be split between Factions. Alliance-icon effects require holding that Faction’s Alliance; numeric Influence requirement icons require at least the shown amount with that Faction.

Keep Intrigue cards face down and separate from deck; may look at them anytime, reveal only when playing; played cards discard face up by Intrigue deck, whose discard pile is reshuffled if deck runs out. Plot is during own Agent/Reveal turn, Combat only during Combat, Endgame only at end. A card’s costs/conditions must be met to play it; the summary does not detail any universal exception for avoiding them.
Yes. A delayed Plot such as Charisma or Recruitment Mission can be played during your Agent turn; leave it face up until next Reveal, use it then, and discard it.
A card drawn during Reveal must immediately be revealed and used that turn; it cannot become an Agent turn. Cards drawn after your Reveal stay in hand for next round, when you still draw 5 more.

Ordinary card arrow effects may be declined; optional black-X trashing is optional; a standalone trash instruction is optional, but trashing to pay a cost is required and a non-arrow instruction to trash the card itself is mandatory. Board entry costs must be paid, and Intrigue costs/conditions met. Most other effects are mandatory unless marked “may.” Optional arrow effect can be resolved only once, not repeated by paying again.
Play Bindu Suspension at the start of Agent turn, before anything else. Draw a card, then immediately end your turn; you cannot continue it.

Calculated Hire can take Mentat only from its starting Landsraad space, not from another player or a different deployed space. Sort Through the Chaos winner takes it at start of next round and uses it that round.
answers.evidence: Rulebook clarifications: Calculated Hire; Mentat reward

answers.answer: Yes, it permits an Agent turn with no Agents left by sending an Agent already on a board space, including back to the same space. It cannot reuse once-per-game High Council or Swordmaster and cannot overcome The Voice.
The Voice marks the chosen space with an available Control marker; remove it on your next turn. It stops opponents, including via Kwisatz Haderach, from sending Agents there for one turn.

Affected opponents choose their own discards from their hands, resolving opponents from your left clockwise. Test of Humanity requires choosing something they can actually do: no discarding from an empty hand or losing a deployed troop they do not have.

After setup is complete and before first round, secretly choose two of four Baron tokens and place them Faction-side down on Leader; return other two unseen to box. Reveal later as described for reward, only once per game.

Yes, Demand Respect may use spice just gained from a Conflict reward; To the Victor… can likewise fund it. A win-trigger Intrigue drawn as a victory reward may be played immediately. A win-trigger cannot be played on first-place tie because nobody won.
answers.evidence: Rulebook clarifications: Demand Respect; Combat Ties

answers.answer: Yes, zero is allowed when an effect permits retreating “any number.” Retreated troops move from Conflict to garrison; lost troops return to supply.
answers.evidence: Special Rules: Losing vs. retreating troops

answers.answer: Assassination Mission does not self-trash to gain 4 Solari; another effect must trash it. Imperial Spy draws Intrigue only when its own self-trash effect is used, not if another effect trashes it.
Yes, keep VP from acquiring The Spice Must Flow if later trashed. Guild Bankers discount applies to each copy acquired that turn.
answers.evidence: FAQ: The Spice Must Flow / Guild Bankers

answers.answer: Corner the Market counts your Spice Must Flow in deck and discard pile. Compare each opponent separately; if any opponent has at least as many as you, second condition fails. First condition is having at least two copies.

Ruthless Negotiator triggers only for printed Solari cost of a board space, not a card ability costing Solari. Ariana’s Spice Addict is mandatory and applies only to spice harvested by Agent at Maker space, not other spice gain.
answers.evidence: FAQ: Count Ilban Richese / Countess Ariana Thorvald

answers.answer: Original base spice: Imperial Basin 1, Hagga Basin 2, Great Flat 3; accumulated bonus is not base. Liet counts qualifying cards from Agent turns this round and current Reveal turn, granting 2 Persuasion per qualifying card.

Opponents cannot acquire the set-aside card. You may acquire it by another effect, but Manipulate’s 1-Persuasion discount does not apply then. If not acquired by end of your next Reveal turn, remove it from game.
Double Cross requires at least one opponent troop in Conflict; it does not require your own troop in supply. Gun Thopter’s Agent box does not affect opponent with no garrisoned troops.

Shifting Allegiances may lose and gain Influence with same Faction for net +1, but must pay the one-Influence loss; a zero-Influence Faction cannot pay. Each track has six spaces; 3 Influence is immediately above the 2-Influence VP space.

Recruitment Mission’s destination choice applies only to cards acquired during Reveal turn that round, not Agent-turn acquisitions. Choose separately for each card acquired during Reveal whether atop deck or discard.
Refocus reshuffles your deck if discard pile is empty. Cards drawn during Reveal must immediately be revealed and used during that turn.
Missionaria Protectiva is Bene Gesserit; after correcting misprints include only two copies in Imperium deck.
Yes. You can score above 12 VP; end of printed Score track is not a limit.
Rivals are affected by effects targeting opponents/players if they have specified resources. Hagal gets no Influence-track bonuses; Signet Ring icons have no effect in two-player play (solo-only).

Hagal acts after each First Player Agent turn; it does not act after second human’s turns or after a Reveal turn. A Swordmaster gives First Player a third Agent and can allow Hagal a third turn instead of two. Actual number follows First Player’s actual Agent turns and Hagal Agents remaining, max three; Mentat or recalled Agent can also allow another turn, while early Reveal can reduce count.
answers.evidence: Two-player House Hagal Rival: Agent turns

answers.answer: Ordinary Persuasion cannot buy Foldspace; it requires an acquire-Foldspace icon, normally from Foldspace board space.
You retain existing City and Fremen icons; Dispatch adds only missing Faction Agent icons and never creates duplicate icons, so no second Fremen icon.

Yes, troops recruited this turn from any source, including Intrigue, may deploy when you send Agent to Combat space, along with up to 2 more from garrison. You cannot re-recruit existing garrison troops to evade the limit.

Draw the one card remaining, then when unable to draw, shuffle discard pile to form new deck and continue drawing. Cards still face up in play are not specified as part of discard pile; only discard pile is reshuffled. Summary says Agent/Reveal cards stay in play until Clean Up, so they are not in that pile.
answers.evidence: Special Rules: Deck exhaustion; Reveal turn Clean Up

answers.answer: Shuffle each human’s identical starting 10-card deck and place face down left of Leader. Shuffle Imperium deck face down and deal 5 face-up Row; shuffle Intrigue deck face down; set separate Reserve stacks for Arrakis Liaison, Spice Must Flow and Foldspace. Place Mentat on side on its space and Alliance tokens on tracks. Choose one First Player randomly and give them marker; in two-player also set up Hagal.

Unused components/troops in supply are placed there in clear view of all players. Intrigue cards remain face down, separate from deck; only their owner may look at them at any time, so their faces are not public.
You may spend Persuasion before, between, or after Reveal effects; no need to finish all effects first.

City icon accesses Arrakeen, Carthag, Sietch Tabr, Research Station. Landsraad accesses High Council, Swordmaster, Hall of Oratory, Rally Troops, Mentat. Spice Trade accesses Imperial Basin, Hagga Basin, Great Flat, Secure Contract, Sell Melange.

Phase 2 starts with First Player marker holder, then clockwise, one turn at a time. On each turn choose Agent or Reveal. Players generally take Agent turns until out, but Reveal is optional while Agents remain; after Reveal turns are skipped for that player. Phase ends once all have Revealed.
8 strength wins top reward, 6 gets second, 4 gets nothing as ordinary third place in 3-player game. In 4-player ordinary third place earns third reward.

At start of Combat, if Hagal has troop in Conflict, reveal Hagal card for sword bonus (reshuffle and reveal again if Reshuffle); humans then play Combat Intrigue before resolution. Hagal gets no bonus-card reveal when it has no troop.
answers.evidence: Two-player House Hagal Rival: Combat strength procedure

answers.answer: At Endgame, gain 1 VP for at least two Spice Must Flow cards and a separate 1 VP for having more than each opponent. Both conditions score 2 total; either alone scores 1; neither scores none.
Yes. Sardaukar Legion Reveal box deploys up to 3 troops from garrison to Conflict; resolve during Reveal effects before Set Strength, so they count immediately.

Landsraad Popularity discounts by 1 Solari entry cost of Landsraad (green) board space when Leto sends Agent there; apply discount before paying. No other category. Prudent Diplomacy optionally pays 1 spice for 1 Influence with a Faction where an opponent has more Influence; cannot target when no opponent is ahead (a tie alone is ineligible).

Choose Maker space with most bonus spice; tie-break by total spice (base plus bonus). If none has bonus spice, reveal another Hagal card. Harvested bonus spice is removed from space and returned to bank; Hagal does not accumulate resources.
answers.evidence: Two-player House Hagal Rival: Harvest Spice

answers.answer: Choose two different Factions from four gain-one Influence icons, gaining 1 in each. Cannot put both in one Faction; this differs from generic gain-two icon, which also cannot be split.
Master Tactician offers 3 swords OR retreat up to 3 troops; one play chooses one, not both. Retreated troops move from Conflict to garrison.
answers.evidence: Intrigue cards; Losing vs. retreating troops
